title: Kubernetes Health Check Probe
description: Standard liveness and readiness probe configuration
content:
livenessProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /healthz/live
    port: 8080
  initialDelaySeconds: 15
  periodSeconds: 10
  failureThreshold: 3
  timeoutSeconds: 5

readinessProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /healthz/ready
    port: 8080
  initialDelaySeconds: 5
  periodSeconds: 5
  failureThreshold: 3
  timeoutSeconds: 3

startupProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /healthz/startup
    port: 8080
  failureThreshold: 30
  periodSeconds: 10
